import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind

# Extract the gender and degree completion columns
gender = df["Sex of respondent, 1979"]
degree_completion = df["Highest grade completed, 1979"]

# Convert gender to a categorical variable (1: Male, 2: Female)
gender = pd.Categorical(gender, categories=[1, 2], ordered=False)

# Split the data by gender
male_degrees = degree_completion[gender == 1]
female_degrees = degree_completion[gender == 2]

# Perform an independent t-test to compare the means of degree completion between genders
t_statistic, p_value = ttest_ind(male_degrees, female_degrees)

t_statistic, p_value

# Check for missing values in the degree completion column
missing_values = degree_completion.isnull().sum()
print("Missing values in degree completion column:", missing_values)

# Check the data type of the degree completion column
print("Data type of degree completion column:", degree_completion.dtype)
